effects.description: [Once Per Turn] This effect can be activated when your opponent attacks. Give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards -1000 power during this turn.
conditions: You have not used this effect yet this turn
steps: (Optional) Choose 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards
Give the chosen card -1000 power during this turn
notes: You can only use this effect once per turn
This effect activates only when your opponent attacks
You may choose not to use this effect even if the condition is met
